[[Metal Slug Attack]] | sprite = [[File:Coffin.gif]][[File:Coffin.png]] }} The '''Mummy Generator''', also known as '''Mummy Gate''', is an [[Environmental Objects|environmental object]] introduced in ''[[Metal Slug 2]]''. == Information == Mummy Generators are usually found inside Egyptian-like locations. It resembles a phone booth with a "MUMMY" sign on top, and is connected to an underground morgue containing Mummies. Mummy Generators will endlessly spawn [[Mummies]] until it's destroyed. Some generators spawn [[Dog Mummy|Dog Mummies]]. The Mummy Generator appears in [[Metal Slug Defense|''Metal Slug Defense'']] purchasable for 120 medals. A few generators are found in a few levels as obstacles. A variant that spawn [[Mummy Cat|Mummy Cats]] appears in ''[[Metal Slug Attack]]'' as a Rare Boss unit for the "Pharaoh Rebirth" Extra Ops. Unit parts can be earned by playing through the second level of the Another Story "Arabian Romance".{{Enemies}}
